source.original_text: For natural \(n\ge3\) and real \(\kappa\ge4\), put \(s=\sqrt\kappa\), \(r=(1-1/n)(s-1)/(s+1)\) and \(\ell=(4ns+(s-1)^2)/(8n(n-1))\). Let \(\mu\) be normalized Haar probability on full \(O(n)\), \(U=O_{11}\), \(A_O=((\kappa+1)/2)I-((\kappa-1)/4)(O+O^\top)\), and \(\gamma_O=\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1})\) on actual Euclidean space. Define \(q(O)=((s+1)U-(s-1))/(1+r^2-2rU)^{n/2}\), with real half-dimension powers. Then \(q\in L^1(\mu)\) and \(\mathbb E_\mu[\det(O)\int e^{-\ell\|x\|_2^2}\,d\gamma_O]=[(-1)^{n-1}(s-1)^{n-1}/(s+1)^n](1-1/n)^{n/2}\mathbb E_\mu q\). Positivity and all required domains and L1 are proved internally; no sphere law or Poisson value is assumed.

∀ {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : 4 ≤ κ),
    let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt κ
    let r : ℝ := (1 - 1 / (n : ℝ)) * ((s - 1) / (s + 1))
    let ℓ : ℝ := (4 * (n : ℝ) * s + (s - 1) ^ 2) /
      (8 * (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1))
    let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
    let U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ :=
      fun O => (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) j0 j0
    let q : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ := fun O =>
      ((s + 1) * U O - (s - 1)) /
        (1 + r ^ 2 - 2 * r * U O) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)
    let γ : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
      fun O => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
        (((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose))⁻¹
    Integrable q (Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ))) ∧
      (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det *
          (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), Real.exp (-ℓ * ‖x‖ ^ 2) ∂γ O)
        ∂(Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ)))) =
        (((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (s - 1) ^ (n - 1)) / (s + 1) ^ n) *
          (1 - 1 / (n : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) * (∫ O, q O ∂(Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ))))

blind_reconstruction.text:
For every natural number n >= 3 and every real number κ >= 4, set
s = sqrt(κ),
r = (1 - 1/n)(s - 1)/(s + 1), and
ℓ = (4ns + (s - 1)^2)/(8n(n - 1)).
Let μ be normalized Haar probability measure on the entire real orthogonal group O(n), including both determinant signs. For O in O(n), write U(O) = O_{00} and define
q(O) = ((s + 1)U(O) - (s - 1)) / (1 + r^2 - 2rU(O))^(n/2).
Let γ_O be the centered Gaussian measure on Euclidean R^n with covariance
C_O = [((κ + 1)/2)I_n - ((κ - 1)/4)(O + O^T)]^(-1).
Then q is absolutely integrable with respect to μ, and
∫_{O(n)} det(O) [∫_{R^n} exp(-ℓ ||x||_2^2) dγ_O(x)] dμ(O)
= [(-1)^(n-1)(s - 1)^(n-1)/(s + 1)^n] (1 - 1/n)^(n/2) ∫_{O(n)} q(O) dμ(O).
Here n/2 in real powers is a real exponent, all dimensional fractions use real arithmetic, and n-1 in the integer powers is the natural-number difference.

import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.SelectedTilt
import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.GaussianExpectation

open Matrix MeasureTheory
open AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.OrthogonalHaar
open AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.DeterminantFamily
/-!
The source-implicit real-power normalization between Eq23 and Eq24 in
Zhou--Suzuki arXiv:2610.20492v1. The actual full-Haar kernel is absolutely L1.
Sphere pushforward and the two Poisson integrals remain separate obligations.
-/
namespace AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.PoissonNormalization
set_option autoImplicit false
theorem selected_gaussian_normalization {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) :
    let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt κ
    let r : ℝ := (1 - 1 / (n : ℝ)) * ((s - 1) / (s + 1))
    let ℓ : ℝ := (4 * (n : ℝ) * s + (s - 1) ^ 2) /
      (8 * (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1))
    let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
    let U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ :=
      fun O => (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) j0 j0
    let q : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ := fun O =>
      ((s + 1) * U O - (s - 1)) /
        (1 + r ^ 2 - 2 * r * U O) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)
    let γ : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
      fun O => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
        (singleBlockPrecision κ O)⁻¹
    Integrable q (orthogonalHaar n) ∧
      (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det *
          (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), Real.exp (-ℓ * ‖x‖ ^ 2) ∂γ O)
        ∂orthogonalHaar n) =
        (((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (s - 1) ^ (n - 1)) / (s + 1) ^ n) *
          (1 - 1 / (n : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) * (∫ O, q O ∂orthogonalHaar n) := by
  classical
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt κ
  let r : ℝ := (1 - 1 / (n : ℝ)) * ((s - 1) / (s + 1))
  let ℓ : ℝ := (4 * (n : ℝ) * s + (s - 1) ^ 2) /
    (8 * (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1))
  let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
  let U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ :=
    fun O => (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) j0 j0
  let q : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ := fun O =>
    ((s + 1) * U O - (s - 1)) /
      (1 + r ^ 2 - 2 * r * U O) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)
  let γ : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
    fun O => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
      (singleBlockPrecision κ O)⁻¹
  change Integrable q (orthogonalHaar n) ∧ _
  have hsel := SelectedTilt.selected_tilt hn hκ
  change 0 < r ∧ r < 1 ∧ 0 < ℓ ∧ _ at hsel
  obtain ⟨hr, hr1, hℓ, _hell, _hcoeff, hmatch⟩ := hsel
  have hn3 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by linarith
  have hn1 : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) - 1 := by linarith
  have hs : 0 ≤ s := Real.sqrt_nonneg κ
  have hp : 0 < s + 1 := by linarith
  let a : ℝ := 1 - 1 / (n : ℝ)
  let p : ℝ := (n : ℝ) / 2
  let C : ℝ := (n : ℝ) * (s + 1) ^ 2 / (2 * ((n : ℝ) - 1))
  let b : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ := fun O =>
    1 + r ^ 2 - 2 * r * U O
  have ha : 0 < a := by
    have hdiv : (1 : ℝ) / n < 1 := (div_lt_one hn0).2 (by linarith)
    dsimp [a]
    linarith
  have hC : 0 < C := by dsimp [C]; positivity
  have htwoC : 2 * C = (s + 1) ^ 2 / a := by
    dsimp [C, a]
    field_simp [hn0.ne', hn1.ne']
  have hbpos (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) : 0 < b O := by
    have huabs : |U O| ≤ 1 := by
      simpa only [U, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        entry_norm_bound_of_unitary O.property j0 j0
    have hu : U O ≤ 1 := (abs_le.mp huabs).2
    have hsq : 0 < (1 - r) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hr1)
    have hprod : 0 ≤ r * (1 - U O) := mul_nonneg hr.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hu)
    dsimp [b]
    nlinarith
  have hU : Continuous U := continuous_subtype_val.matrix_elem j0 j0
  have hbcont : Continuous b := by dsimp [b]; fun_prop
  have hqcont : Continuous q := by
    change Continuous (fun O => ((s + 1) * U O - (s - 1)) / (b O) ^ p)
    exact ((continuous_const.mul hU).sub continuous_const).div
      (hbcont.rpow_const (fun O => Or.inl (hbpos O).ne'))
      (fun O => (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hbpos O) p).ne')
  let := (orthogonalHaar_spec n).1
  have hqL : Integrable q (orthogonalHaar n) :=
    hqcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (isClosed_tsupport q).isCompact
  have hpow2 : ((s + 1) ^ 2) ^ p = (s + 1) ^ n := by
    calc
      ((s + 1) ^ 2) ^ p = (s + 1) ^ ((2 : ℝ) * p) :=
        (Real.rpow_natCast_mul hp.le 2 p).symm
      _ = (s + 1) ^ (n : ℝ) := by congr 1; dsimp [p]; ring
      _ = (s + 1) ^ n := Real.rpow_natCast _ _
  have hscale : (2 : ℝ) ^ p * C ^ p = (s + 1) ^ n / a ^ p := by
    rw [← Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hC.le, htwoC,
      Real.div_rpow (sq_nonneg _) ha.le, hpow2]
  have hpref :
      (((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (s - 1) ^ (n - 1)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ p) * (C ^ p)⁻¹ =
        (((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (s - 1) ^ (n - 1)) / (s + 1) ^ n) * a ^ p := by
    calc
      _ = ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (s - 1) ^ (n - 1)) /
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * C ^ p) := by
        simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, _root_.mul_inv_rev]
        ring
      _ = ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (s - 1) ^ (n - 1)) /
          ((s + 1) ^ n / a ^ p) := by rw [hscale]
      _ = _ := by
        field_simp [(Real.rpow_pos_of_pos ha p).ne', pow_ne_zero n hp.ne']
  have hden (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) :
      κ + 1 + 4 * ℓ - (κ - 1) * U O = C * b O :=
    (hmatch (U O)).1.trans (hmatch (U O)).2
  have hg := GaussianExpectation.actual_gaussian_transform hn hκ hℓ.le
  refine ⟨hqL, ?_⟩
  calc
    _ = (((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (s - 1) ^ (n - 1)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ p) *
        (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
          ((s + 1) * U O - (s - 1)) /
            (κ + 1 + 4 * ℓ - (κ - 1) * U O) ^ p ∂orthogonalHaar n) := hg.2.2
    _ = (((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (s - 1) ^ (n - 1)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ p) *
        ((C ^ p)⁻¹ * (∫ O, q O ∂orthogonalHaar n)) := by
      congr 1
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun O => by
        change ((s + 1) * U O - (s - 1)) /
          (κ + 1 + 4 * ℓ - (κ - 1) * U O) ^ p = (C ^ p)⁻¹ * q O
        rw [hden O, Real.mul_rpow hC.le (hbpos O).le]
        change ((s + 1) * U O - (s - 1)) / (C ^ p * (b O) ^ p) =
          (C ^ p)⁻¹ * (((s + 1) * U O - (s - 1)) / (b O) ^ p)
        simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, _root_.mul_inv_rev]
        ring
    _ = _ := by rw [← mul_assoc, hpref]

end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.PoissonNormalization

steps.title: Use the actual selected parameters
steps.text: Apply the identical compiled selection theorem. It supplies the positive tilt, the radius interval and the literal affine matching. These conditions are not copied into the public hypotheses.
steps.lean: hsel and hden call SelectedTilt.selected_tilt exactly; all n, square-root and coefficient domains are derived internally.

steps.title: Keep the actual coordinate in its range
steps.text: Orthogonality gives the coordinate bound. The normalized denominator is uniformly positive, so the quotient is continuous on compact full O(n) and absolutely integrable under its Haar probability. This step is essential before the real-power rule.
steps.lean: hbpos uses canonical entry_norm_bound_of_unitary and the compiled radius bounds. hqcont uses Continuous.rpow_const and Continuous.div; hqL directly calls Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport with the existing Haar probability, without cloning a generic compact-integration lemma.

steps.title: Scale the positive real power
steps.text: Write p=n/2 and a=1-1/n. Both factors in the matched denominator are positive. The positive-base multiplication law therefore applies even when n is odd.
steps.lean: The pointwise final integral congruence uses hden, hC, hbpos and canonical Real.mul_rpow. The actual coordinate range is a consumed proof dependency, not positivity for an arbitrary real u.

steps.title: Simplify the entire prefactor
steps.text: Normalize the coefficient together with the original factor of two. Converting the squared base to the natural n-th power uses real exponent multiplication, not integer rounding.
steps.lean: htwoC, hpow2, hscale and hpref directly reuse Real.rpow_natCast_mul, Real.rpow_natCast, Real.mul_rpow and Real.div_rpow. Nonzero denominators are established before field normalization.

steps.title: Join the actual Gaussian transform
steps.text: Use the existing actual Gaussian expectation identity at the proved positive tilt, rewrite its denominator and move the constant outside the same full-Haar integral. The normalized expectation is left unevaluated.
steps.lean: hg calls GaussianExpectation.actual_gaussian_transform hn hκ hℓ.le. The final calc uses integral_congr_ae and integral_const_mul, then hpref. The focused test consumes this exact equality in the actual determinant-conditioned Gaussian mixture expectation gap. It does not supply the sphere/Poisson evaluation.
